                improved = True

    optima while keeping most of the ordering structure intact."""

        seq[i], seq[j] = seq[j], seq[i]

        rest = seq[:i] + seq[i + seg_len:]
        j = random.randint(0, len(rest))

                if min_cost is None or c < min_cost:

        if since_best > 150:

            temp = max(1.0, best_cost * 0.02)
